# netbox_owner (Data Source)

A NetBox owner (users.owner): the users and groups an object can be assigned to as its owner.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/owner/):

> An owner is a set of users and/or groups who are responsible for the administration of certain resources within NetBox. The users and groups assigned to an owner are referred to as its members. Owner assignments are useful for indicating which parties are responsible for the administration of a particular object.
>
> Most objects within NetBox can be assigned an owner, although this is not required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_owner" "test" {
  name = "test-owner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_group_id` (Number) Id of the owner group the owner belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `user_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the user groups that make up the owner.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the users that make up the owner.
